targeted_checks.method: `#print axioms` via `lake env lean` at each revision's built tree, parsed from text; class recomputed with transition.kind_of/trust_class

trust_classes.assumption-conditional: a conditional MachLib axiom (declared, OUTSIDE trustedFootprint) entered or left: what the theorem is conditional on changed
trust_classes.assumption-foundation: only MachLib axioms INSIDE trustedFootprint (the approved foundation) entered or left, possibly with standard Lean axioms
trust_classes.other: a compiler-trust or undeclared axiom entered or left
trust_classes.sorry: sorryAx entered or left (must be only the allowlisted theorem)
trust_classes.standard-only: only propext / Classical.choice / Quot.sound entered or left
